# Techno Zone Lanka

> Your trusted source for Nokia mobile phones, audio accessories and gadgets in Sri Lanka — genuine stock, official warranties, islandwide delivery.

## About
Techno Zone Lanka is a Sri Lanka-based electronics retailer specialising in Nokia mobile phones, Samsung smartphones, audio gear, networking solutions, and AI and cloud-connected smart accessories. All products carry official agent warranties and are available with islandwide cash-on-delivery.

## Key pages
- [Shop mobile phones & gadgets](https://technozonelanka.com/en)
- [Browse categories](https://technozonelanka.com/en/search)
- [Phone repairs & services](https://technozonelanka.com/en/services)
- [Warranty check](https://technozonelanka.com/en/warranty)
- [Track a repair](https://technozonelanka.com/en/track)

## Contact
WhatsApp customer support available. See the website for the current number.
